SUBJECT:  Home  Recognition  Program  2024/25-  Selection  of Homes

PURPOSE:  To select  homes  to be recognized  by the City  Council  as part of the City's  Home
Recognition  Program.

RECOMMENDED  ACTION:  Select ten (10) homes,  two from each of the five Areas in the City,
for the City's  Home  Recognition  Program  and direct  staff  to present  the selected  homes  for
recognition  at an upcoming  City  Council  meeting.

ANALYSIS:  The  Home  Recognition  Program  (the "Program")  recognizes  those  who  have
coinmitted  to bearitifying  and maintaining  their homes.  Many  attractive  homes  in the City  inspire
otherresidents  while  raising  coinmunity  pride and spirit.  The Program  will  highlight  and recognize
these  homes  and  motivate  other  residents  to  improve  their  homes,  enhance  residential
neighborhoods,  and improve  the quality  of life for South Gate residents.  The nominated  homes  are
located  throughout  the City and were nominated  by homeowners,  residents,  or City Staff: however,
most nominations  derived  from  the public.

This  year,  the  Community  Development  Department  received  21  nominations  that  met  the
program  eligibility  requirements.  Following  the selection  of the 10 homes,  the City will  notify  the
selected  nominees  of the approval.  Staff  will  invite  the homeowners  to attend  the City  Council
meeting,  where  the Council  will  recognize  them.  Residents  will  be recognized  by the City  Council
during  a Council  meeting  and receive  a certificate  of appreciation.  Residents  will  also  receive  a
lawn sign to be displayed  on their front  lawn,  and a picture  of their home  will  be displayed  at City
Hall.

BACKGROUND:  Over  twenty  years  ago,  the  City  established  a Home  and  Business
Beautification  Award  program  in conjunction  with  the South  Gate Chamber  of Commerce.  The
program's  purpose  was to recognize  homeowners  and businesses  that maintain  their  properties.
For several  years the City  displayed  photographs  of the awardees  homes  and businesses  at City
Hall.  On July 24, 2018, the City  Council  voted to re-establish  the Home  Recognition  Program  and
designate  the Plaru'iing  Commission  as the body  to select nominees  to be recognized  by the City
Council.  Due to COVID-19  pandemic,  the City  put the program  on hold temporarily  and now that
the City  has re-opened,  City  staff has re-initiated  the program.

 Purpose, Goals and Objective of Program
The purpose of the Home Recognition Program is to recognize
residents who have demonstrated a commitment to beautifying
and maintaining their homes. There are many attractive homes
in the City of South Gate that inspire other residents while
raising community pride and spirit. The Program will highlight
and recognize these homes, motivate others to improve their
homes, enhance residential neighborhoods and improve quality
of life for South Gate residents.

The program has three components:

Promotion and nominations
Selection of winners
Recognition by City Council

• The property must not have any property maintenance

  yard, inoperable vehicles, unpermitted canopies, discarded
  house items, and visible cracked concrete etc.

SUBJECT:  PROPOSED  MURAL  FOR  AN  EXISTING  BUSINESS  LOCATED  AT  3801
TWEEDY  BOULEVARD  ("YURI'S  RECORDS")

PURPOSE:  Consideration  of arequest  for after-the-fact  approval  of a sign permitto  allow  a mural
painting  on a property  located  at 3801 Tweedy  Blvd.

BACKGROUND:

Applicant:  Surrounding  Land  Uses:
Jacqueline  Ferfan,  Business  Owner  North:  NM
Gabby  Fiqueroa,  Representative  East: TMU2
3801 Tweedy  Boulevard  South:  TMU2
South  Gate, CA 90280  West:  TMU2

Existing  Zoning:  General  Plan  Designation:
TMU2  - Tweedy  Boulevard  Specific  Plan  Tweedy  [Sub Area  5]

Site Characteristics:

The subject  site/business  is located  at the northeast  corner  of San Gabriel  Avenue  and Tweedy
Boulevard.  The site is currently  occupied  by Yuri's  Records,  an independently  owned  family  retail
business  specializing  in music  records  and skateboarding  merchandise.  The business  has been
operating  in South  Gate since 1976.

In September  of 2023,  Leobardo  Trevizo  Jr. (artist)  saw an opportunity,  with  the pernnission  of
Yuri's  Records,  to donate  time by painting  a portrait  (mural)  of an influential  local  skater by the
name of Vincent  Nava. As a child,  Vincent  Nava  was a sponsored  skater by Yuri's  records  located
in South  Gate.  The  goal  of the mural  was  to create  a landmark  where  the current  and new
generation  of skaters  can get inspired  and remember  how passionate  he was with  his craft and was
always  willing  to teach the youth.

The theme  of the proposed  mural "Eternal  Legends:  A Tribute  to Vincent  Nava",  seeks to honor
the enduring  legacy  and timeless  influence  of an influential  skateboarder  of the community  who
has le'ft an indelible  mark  on the world  of skateboarding  and beyond.  The artist believes  the mural
transforms  a blank  wall  to a captivating  work  of art that enriches  the community  by attracting
visitors,  fostering  a sense  of  pride,  connection,  and  appreciation  among  the  surrounding
neighborhood.

  36
 ANALYSIS:

Proiect Description:
The applicant  Gabby  Fiqueroa  (Representative),  on behalf  of Yuri's  Records  (Business  owner),
submitted  a request  to legalize  an unpermitted  mural.  The  proposed  mural  (to be legalized)  is
located  on the westerly  building  fagade, fronting  San Gabriel  Avenue  and measures  approximately
19 feet 5 inches  in width  and 14 feet 5 inches  in height.  The mural  is visible  to pedestrian  and
vehicular  traffic  traveling  north  and south on San Gabriel  Avenue  and traveling  east on Tweedy
Boulevard.  The artist used  mediums  such as spray paint,  exterior  acrylic  paint,  and paint  brushes
to complete  the project.

The mural  was painted  by Leobardo  Trevizo  Jr., a South  Gate native,  who is an artist based out of
Los Angeles.  Trevizo  Jr. has been previously  cornrnissioned  to paint  several  murals  throughout
the Los Angeles  region;  depicting  inspirational  artists  who  have passed  away.  Examples  of his
previous  artwork  include  a Nipsey  Hussle  Tribute  Canvas,  which  was featured  in the Stay Gallery
in Downey;  an interior  abstract  mural  located  in Mag Park (Magnolia  Park),  a popular  sneaker  and
streetwear  retail  store; and lastly,  an exterior  mural  for Performax  Physical  Therapy  Facility  which
is located  in Burbank  (Attachment  C).

Municipal  Code Requirements:
Pursuant  to South  Gate Municipal  Code  (SGMC)  Chapter  11.36.090(2)(f),  any painted  wall  sign
that  does not  pertain  to  the  business,  product  or service  rendered  on the premises  shall  be
considered  a mural.  The  size,  height,  locations,  and other  restrictions  shall  be reviewed  by the
Planning  Commission.

CONCLUSION:
The proposed  project  is consistent  with  the intent  of SGMC  Chapter  1 1.36.090(2)(f)  as it satisfies
the criteria  of a "mural"  since it does not advertise  any specific  business,  product,  or service  related
to the premises.  The mural's  design  and dimensions  will  create  a visual  interest  and enhance  the
overall  aesthetic  of the secondary  fagade  of the subject  building  by creating  a visual  break  within
the long horizontal span of a solid wall  surface  which  lacks architectural  detailing  and introduction
of the proposed artwork.

RECOMMENDATION:

Based  on the evidence  presented,  Staff  recommends  that the Planning  Commission  approves  the
legalization  oftheproposed  mural  subjectto  the recommended  conditions  of approval  (Attachment
A).
